verdict.rationale: DPMA is the German patent and trade mark office. Its offering is search databases (DEPATISnet, DPMAregister) and e-filing routes (DPMAdirektWeb/Pro), not a platform for building user automations, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any automation feature that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
